scientific_distinction.r5_2a_hypothesis: BEST_INSERT may later be compared with the strongest permitted non-addition explanation among KEEP, substitution, and deletion in one exact CTC likelihood space.
scientific_distinction.why_distinct: The denominator changes from a single canonical explanation to an explicit relation-competitive composite. This targets explanation confounding rather than retroactively moving the R5-1 threshold.

families.KEEP: The unchanged expected canonical sequence E.
families.INSERT: E with one canonical phone inserted at boundary b in 0..N.
families.SUBSTITUTION: E with expected position i replaced by one of the other 39 canonical phones.
families.DELETE: E with expected position i omitted.

substitution_words.reason: A true substitution can make KEEP acoustically poor. An insertion hypothesis can then win against KEEP even if replacement is the better sequence explanation. BEST_SUB gives that replacement an explicit competitor.

deletion_words.reason: A true deletion can make KEEP acoustically poor. Some INSERT target can score above KEEP without representing the true relation. BEST_DELETE supplies the omitted-phone explanation in the same likelihood space.

correct_only_words.reason: KEEP already competes in R5-1. SUB/DELETE can help only when model confusion makes an edited non-addition sequence score above KEEP; there is no guaranteed improvement for the largest false-positive cohort.

class_overlap_targeting.reason: The new competitors directly represent two frozen false-positive cohorts and can also strengthen the non-addition reference for some correct words, but one-edit score overlap can remain.

speaker_shift_targeting.reason: All competing scores share the same word, logits, speaker, and TARGET score convention, so common within-word location components may cancel. However R5-1 was already a within-word INSERT-minus-KEEP comparison and still shifted; relative relation preferences can remain speaker-dependent. Cancellation cannot be claimed.

future_binary_contract_feasible.addition_rule: Feasible in principle: ADDITION only when BEST_INSERT exceeds the strongest permitted non-addition explanation by a separately preregistered criterion.
future_binary_contract_feasible.when_nonaddition_wins: Return NON_ADDITION for the binary task. The winning KEEP/SUB/DELETE family may be retained as a diagnostic, but R5-2A does not validate a complete multiclass relation output.
